description: This file defines a React functional component called ViewDetailsModal which renders a modal dialog displaying details of a JSON object. It includes utility functions for formatting labels and currency values, and handles special cases like displaying user cost data with customized formatting. The component is designed to be reusable and generic for various JSON data structures.
